**Sugar-Free Nukashine** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A sugar-free version of Nukashine, with the lack of sugar allowing the beverage to be consumed without any risk of blackouts.

A high-proof distilled liquor brewed using Nuka-Cola Quantum and Nuclear Material, fresh Nukashine decreases the AP cost of sprinting by 80%, increases AP regeneration by 50%, and increase falling speed by 25% while inflicting 30 Rads.

Use of the Good With Salt perk or a refrigerated backpack mod will cause the fermentation rate to slow as it uses the same game mechanic as spoilage.

Art by Jake Raymor
